Original UI assets generated with the built-in image_gen tool on 2026-10-24.
No external game artwork was supplied or downloaded.
HUD source: 2141 x 734 RGBA. Atlas standardized to 1024 x 512 and cut into eight 256 x 256 WebP tiles with Sharp.

PROMPT 1 — HUD FRAME
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original raster game HUD skin, isolated transparent PNG. Create one very wide panoramic horizontal gothic dark fantasy HUD bar, intended final canvas 1400 by 240 pixels, front-facing perfectly flat orthographic UI object. No words, numbers, logos, badges or watermark. Entire exterior background must be transparent. Two perfectly round EMPTY resource orb openings: center left at (100,120), center right at (1300,120), inner diameter 138 pixels. The interior disks must also be transparent, absolutely NO colored liquid or painted glass inside the holes, because live red and blue resource fills will be placed behind them in code. Surround each orb with a richly sculpted aged silver and dark bronze circular rim, subtle gothic arch filigree, restrained abstract bone-wing and folded metal ornament, no skulls or blood. Between the orbs, a substantial continuous rectangular ancient charcoal stone-and-forged-metal console, from x205 to x1195, y90 to y208, with clean dark inset room for four live square skill icons and a potion belt. The middle must be visually quiet, dark, empty and usable, not covered by ornament. Sculpted top edge and shallow brass border along the lower edge. Medieval dungeon craft, authentic worn cold iron, tarnished antique brass, chipped basalt, finely carved relief, believable metal material highlights and deep occlusion. Premium hand-painted 3D game UI asset quality, high legibility, symmetric silhouette but original artistic detail. Thin wing relief can project above the center panel but remain within the 240-pixel-height banner. Show the whole HUD with a few pixels of transparent breathing room; do not crop any outer ornaments. No background scene, no perspective view, no reference game logos, no embedded skill icons.

PROMPT 2 — EIGHT ICON ATLAS
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original dark fantasy game icon atlas to be cut into 8 equal tiles. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows regular grid, final 1024 by 512 pixels, each square tile 256 by 256. No margins between tiles and no outside border: all eight cells same exact size, borders aligned at x=0/256/512/768/1024 and y=0/256/512. Each cell has its own matching thin 8-pixel antique gold frame, very dark near-black inner background, one bold centered item or spell image, with enough silhouette separation to remain readable at 50px. No text, numbers, letters, logos or watermark anywhere, including on keys and documents. Rich realistic painted dark gothic fantasy RPG inventory / spell icon aesthetic, sculpted highlights, aged brass, cold steel, worn leather, painterly detail, premium original game art. Top row left to right: 1) ATTACK, a powerful gothic greatsword made from a metal mechanical keyboard, diagonal blade with blank dark keycaps and a silver cutting edge, strong silver slash glow; 2) BURST, several office documents caught in a brilliant cyan-blue magical explosion, flying blank paper sheets around a luminous arcane core, clear spell action; 3) DASH, a golden human-shaped fleeting sidestep silhouette with three glowing afterimages and a sweeping amber trail, energetic left-to-right motion; 4) POTION, a deep-red glass coffee healing flask with bronze neck and coffee-bean relief motif, ruby liquid and warm red magic light. Bottom row left to right: 5) WEAPON, a hefty isolated battle-worn metal mechanical keyboard with blank keycaps, diagonal three-quarter item view, polished cold steel and bronze details; 6) ARMOR, an isolated dark brown leather armored hoodie, hood up, no person or face, brass clasps and stitched hide shoulders, substantial protective garment; 7) CHARM, a golden employee identification badge on a dark lanyard, abstract raised sun emblem with no writing or portrait, warm enchanted glow; 8) GOLD, a small dimensional pile of old gold coins, warmly lit embossed abstract geometric emblems, no letters. Keep each subject entirely inside its own tile and do not let effects cross tile frames. Precisely uniform straight grid; do not add labels or a scene.

PROMPT 3 — HUD RESOURCE SPHERES (EDIT OF PROMPT 1 OUTPUT)
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied original forged gothic horizontal HUD artwork. Preserve the exact same original carved silver-and-bronze metal frame, black stone center console, symmetric layout, all ornament and material quality, front-on flat UI framing. Make only these targeted changes: Fill the left round orb opening with a gorgeous deep ruby-red magical liquid/glass orb, and fill the right opening with an equally gorgeous luminous cobalt-blue magical liquid/glass orb. Both resource spheres are completely full, subtle internal swirling light, elegant glossy crescent specular highlights near upper left, darker bottom edges, no marks and no numbers. Each sphere must remain exactly inside its existing round opening behind the metal rim. Preserve original true transparency outside the whole HUD. Crop the canvas to remove excessive top and bottom empty transparent space, leaving just 8-12 pixels of transparent breathing room around the outer silhouette, so it is a directly usable panoramic UI strip. Keep the whole exterior frame visible and uncropped. Do not alter the central empty space; no additional slots, icons, text, labels, symbols or logos. This is the final production PNG image asset, no background scene.
